property_summary: For any filled long order, the position's expiration is recorded under the long position id uint256(hashOrder(order)) (i.e. positionExpirations[uint256(orderHash)] == block.timestamp + duration); the mutant keys it under the opposite short id instead, leaving the long id's expiration zero.
change_summary: Always key the expiration by positionId instead of the conditional, so long orders record the expiration under the opposite (short position) id rather than the order hash.
